'''Gelemeade''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] with at least four [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a routine scan of [[Gelemeade's fourth moon]] detected signs of simple organic life beneath its uninhabitable surface, and further investigation found a variety of exotic life underground.<ref name="Mission" />
